game.name: No Rest for the Wicked
game.frameNote: Frames are simulation frames at 60 fps, 1-based: startup is the first frame a hitbox is out. Charged attacks are timed from the release; holding the button first takes the frames shown as charge.

source.name: No Rest for the Wicked game files
source.author: Moon Studios
source.note: No Rest for the Wicked data is read straight from the game files (Steam build 22928553): hitbox windows, cancel windows, i-frames and armor from each action's timeline in the gameplay database, movesets from each weapon's action selection. Damage numbers scale with the weapon and are not shown yet.
